items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017
items.q: I asked Coleman Hawkins... I always sought counsel.

ctx.x: That’s good. Okay so did people tell you, “You’ve got to move on. You’ve got to go to New York” did you hear that?

That’s so good. There’s two ways I heard it. Every musician, some of who worked in Las Vegas, some of whom worked with what they call carnivals traveling around. They always said, see we have a saying about — Cincinnati is a good place to be from. Which is true. So a lot of the musicians when they came through and they saw it was a young guy, would say, “Don’t get stuck here. Get out of here. Don’t get stuck.” Like that. And then there was a school teacher who was frustrated and he was a jazz musician and he…
What were some of the — did you play with rhythm and blues bands and swing bands?
